scientific_integrity: The unrestricted probability-law optimum is proved by three exact global affine lower supports. A standalone SymPy script checks exact identities and illustrative finite-grid inequalities; finite tests are not used as universal proof. Publication-priority comparison is based on inspected accessible literature and mathematical records, and is not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar Dahlquist decay only; one fixed positive step, exact stage solves, iid stages, arbitrary Borel stage laws constrained to have mean one half. Optimum depends on the known dimensionless stiffness and concerns expected squared numerical amplitude, not global discretization error, nonautonomous convergence order, or simultaneous multi-eigenvalue design.
title: Three sharp optimal stage laws for mean-preserving randomized implicit Runge–Kutta damping
